욥기 29:1.content: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

욥기 29:2.content: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

욥기 29:3.content: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

욥기 29:4.content: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

욥기 29:5.content: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

욥기 29:6.content: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

욥기 29:7.content: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

욥기 29:8.content: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

욥기 29:9.content: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

욥기 29:10.content: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

욥기 29:11.content: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

욥기 29:12.content: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

욥기 29:13.content: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

욥기 29:14.content: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

욥기 29:15.content: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

욥기 29:16.content: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

욥기 29:17.content: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

욥기 29:18.content: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

욥기 29:19.content: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

욥기 29:20.content: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

욥기 29:21.content: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

욥기 29:22.content: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

욥기 29:23.content: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

욥기 29:24.content: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

욥기 29:25.content: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
